verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs describe backing up and syncing to a self-hosted network, with a team-maintained Docker image. The app itself is local-first and works offline, and a CLI can run Anytype as a headless server; the team also says p2p sync works without a central server. The main caveat is that switching to a self-hosted network requires exporting channels and importing them into a new identity. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment, detailed setup docs in the evidence beyond needing a network configuration, and a smooth migration path that avoids creating a new identity.
